subject: Re: Compact week at Solvex — propose staggered sessions + recording
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@solvex.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Compact week at Solvex — coordinating windows

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for inviting us out for the week of Nov 15 — super excited to walk the team through the integration work and run the hands-on sessions. I saw the tentative itinerary your team shared and noticed a couple of overlaps with the exec schedule (field visits on Tue/Thu afternoon). To make the week most productive for everyone, can we propose the following?:

- Keep the full product walkthrough on Mon 10:00–11:30 (SE + product demo)
- Stagger the hands-on deep-dive into two 60-min blocks: Tue 09:00–10:00 (platform + security) and Wed 14:00–15:00 (performance + deployment patterns)
- Record the Tue deep-dive and share the short recording + annotated notes for any execs who miss it

If stacked in one long block your execs are likely to step out for field work — staggering gives them a good chance to join at least one live session, and the recording covers gaps. I attached a lightweight version of the itinerary with the proposed windows.

Would you be open to the staggered plan? If not, tell me which people/time windows are fixed on your side and we’ll adapt.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0184

Attachment: Solvex-week-itinerary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@solvex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Compact week at Solvex — coordinating windows

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the thoughtfulness. Two quick constraints from our side:

1) Our CTO (Michael O'Neill) is traveling on Tue morning and won't be available until late afternoon — he can do Wed morning or Thu morning.
2) A couple of our managers will be out Mon afternoon for an on-site customer visit, so the Mon morning slot you proposed looks good for the broad walkthrough.

Recording is definitely helpful; can you confirm how long the recording will be and whether you can include the SE's runbook/notes so our engineers can pick up quickly? Also, if you can shift the performance session earlier on Wed (11:00 instead of 14:00) that would work better with our internal agenda.

Elena
Elena Torres
VP, Product Operations | Solvex
elena.torres@solvex.com | 617-555-3241
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@solvex.com>, Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@solvex.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Compact week at Solvex — coordinating windows

Perfect — thanks for the specifics. Quick responses and revised plan below: 

- Mon 10:00–11:30: Broad product walkthrough (confirmed)
- Tue 09:00–10:00: Security + platform deep-dive — we will record (~60 min) and produce a 10–12 minute highlight with timestamps
- Wed 11:00–12:00: Performance & deployment patterns (moved earlier as requested)

Deliverables we’ll provide with the recording:
- SE runbook (step-by-step checklist for local test harness)
- Short annotated slide deck with key config snippets
- Link to the raw recording + 12-min highlight clip

I attached a revised itinerary (Solvex-week-itinerary.pdf) and a tiny text file with our recording & sharing guidelines (session-recording-guidelines.txt). Michael — if Wed morning works for you to join the performance session, that would be great; if not, Rishi can run a live sync later that day and we’ll share docs.

Next steps: Elena, confirm Wed 11:00 is OK for your CTO and I’ll lock the calendar invites.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: Solvex-week-itinerary.pdf, session-recording-guidelines.txt
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: coverage plan for Solvex week (Wed performance session)

Folks — Elena confirmed the Wed 11:00 slot for performance. Michael is aware but may join remotely for the first 20–30 minutes. Action items: 

- Rishi: please prepare the performance checklist and bring the benchmark slides (target 20 mins of live demo + 30 mins Q&A).
- Mina: I'll own the session recording + highlight clip edits; please capture timestamps.
- Jonas: please keep the follow-up playbook (action items and next steps) doc ready so we can hand it to the CS team at the end of the week.

I'll send the calendar invites to all external attendees once Rishi confirms he can lead the Q&A.

Thanks —
Marissa
